gmcm.section.name: Geode Breaking Options
gmcm.break-mode.name: Geode Break Mode
gmcm.break-mode.tooltip: Choose how geodes are broken when inventory is full.
gmcm.anim-speed.name: Animation Speed Multiplier
gmcm.anim-speed.tooltip: Adjust the geode breaking animation speed. Lower = faster. Example: 0.5 = 2x faster. Ignored when 'Skip Breaking Animation' is enabled.
gmcm.skip-animation.name: Skip Breaking Animation
gmcm.skip-animation.tooltip: Skip the geode breaking animation. Rewards are given instantly.
gmcm.play-sound.name: Play Breaking Sound
gmcm.play-sound.tooltip: Play a break sound when cracking geodes. Only applies when 'Skip Breaking Animation' is enabled.
gmcm.mobile-mode.name: Mobile Compatibility Mode
gmcm.mobile-mode.tooltip: Enable this if you're playing on Android/mobile to prevent game crashes.
gmcm.debug-mode.name: Enable Debug Mode
gmcm.debug-mode.tooltip: Enable verbose logging to help with debugging. Turn off for normal gameplay.
gmcm.show-overlay.name: Show Break Count Overlay
gmcm.show-overlay.tooltip: Show the x{N} break count overlay after breaking geodes.
gmcm.overlay-offset-x.name: Overlay Offset X
gmcm.overlay-offset-x.tooltip: Horizontal offset of geode count text. Positive moves right, negative moves left. Adjust on mobile to fit your screen.
gmcm.overlay-offset-y.name: Overlay Offset Y
gmcm.overlay-offset-y.tooltip: Vertical offset of geode count text. Positive moves down, negative moves up. Adjust on mobile to fit your screen.
gmcm.overlay-scale.name: Overlay Font Scale
gmcm.overlay-scale.tooltip: Size of the overlay number. Example: 0.6 = 60% size, 1.0 = full size.
message.no-inventory-space: Not enough inventory space for geode rewards.
